verdict.rationale: Vapi's docs describe building and configuring voice AI assistants for end-users (phone/web calls, tools, testing) and even an MCP server/CLI for managing those assistants, but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant/copilot inside the Vapi product itself that the AI-native user can delegate platform tasks to (e.g., an in-dashboard copilot that configures assistants or writes tools for you). The CLI mentions external IDE assistants (Cursor/Windsurf) gaining API knowledge, but that's a third-party tool, not a built-in in-product assistant.
